scripts.render: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install -q -p .venv 'rendercv[full]' && mkdir -p release && .venv/bin/rendercv render rendercv-onepage.yaml -o out-onepage -pdf release/Rasmus_Soot_CV.pdf
scripts.check: pages=$(ls out-onepage/*_*.png | wc -l); if [ "$pages" -ne 1 ]; then echo "FIT FAIL: rendered $pages pages — the one-pager must stay 1 page"; exit 1; fi; echo "fit check OK: 1 page"
